issues.description: conanfile.py uses replace_in_file on generated 'configure' file for umask and shebang fixes. While R6 discourages modifying generated products, these modifications are applied after autoreconf generates configure during build(), which is a standard Conan pattern for autotools projects that require autoreconf.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using patches for the umask fix (patching configure.ac template), but current approach is acceptable for post-autoreconf modifications.
